policy: Candidates are research hypotheses, not non-U facts, not enabled runtime registers, and not authorized hardware probes.
support_count_policy: Count distinct manual families/revisions separately from truly independent devices. Translation, mirror and copied host/expansion text do not add independent hardware support. No device experiments were performed.

candidates.derivation: U0 and U1 both document this contiguous identity layout. Non-U shares detailed networking/negotiation block 0x7530..0x7589 with U, and N1 p52 demonstrates host and expansion firmware information in official UI. This establishes existence of information, NOT its transport/address.
candidates.alternative: Non-U uses UDP discovery metadata, a private binary command, different registers, or unsupported U-style identity.
conflicts: N1 and E1 omit identity table.
Known DI/AI filter differences show that related M31 generations do not preserve all configuration addresses.
candidates.validation_needed: Prefer vendor confirmation or offline interpretation of already-captured official-tool traffic showing exact non-U model/firmware. Require matching address, FC, lengths and response text before promoting. No active probe was performed.

candidates.derivation: U model array footprint 32*8=256 ends at0x0D7F and firmware array starts immediately at0x0D80. N1 screenshot shows a model tree and separate host/expansion firmware, but no Modbus addresses.
candidates.alternative: Model tree comes from discovery frames; fewer slots; different packing; model string without M31 prefix; built-in host IO slot changes ordering.
conflicts: U supports16 modules including host, yet table reserves32 models/versions and16 storage flags.
U example model MF-AAAX4440 is not current M31-G naming.
N1 screenshot embedded host IO uses GAXAX8080 while top host is M31-AXAX8080G.
candidates.validation_needed: Obtain official slot-index definition and real non-U protocol trace. Confirm where internal host IO appears, physical order, absent marker NONE, byte packing and count limits. Never issue one256-word read: FC03 normal maximum125 words.

candidates.proposed_access: W06, NEVER execute based on hypothesis
candidates.derivation: Explicit U0/U1 command pair; non-U official UI shows restart function but transport not specified.
candidates.alternative: Non-U restart/factory reset are private tool/UDP commands or other registers.
conflicts: No non-U address or magic-value evidence.
Different generations have demonstrated parameter-map changes.
candidates.validation_needed: Vendor documentation or passive official-tool command capture on disposable/approved test equipment; do not write or send discovery frames in this research.

candidates.target: Undetermined words0x753F-0x7540 in non-U/U network parameter block
candidates.derivation: DNS two-word field0x753D..0x753E followed by local port0x7541 leaves two omitted words.
candidates.alternative: Reserved padding; legacy parameter; private configuration; invalid addresses.
conflicts: Regular alignment/gaps do not establish any semantic definition.
candidates.validation_needed: Leave undefined until official map or passive request/response identifies field. Do not label as stop bits, device address, save, UDP port or timeout.

candidates.derivation: N1 and U1 describe UI save then restart; U0/U1 storage-capability and enable arrays concern expansions, not host save command.
candidates.alternative: Writes are automatically persisted; special tool command commits; reload commits; different handling between network and IO fields.
conflicts: Existence of storage-enable0x0C70 does not establish save trigger semantics.
candidates.validation_needed: Official persistence semantics and passive Save traffic capture required; reboot persistence not tested.

candidates.derivation: Official UI supports network Search and upgrade package explicitly requires Ethernet; neither defines discovery packet format, port, or firmware wire command.
candidates.alternative: UDP broadcast/unicast discovery, TCP probing, proprietary framing, separate bootloader protocol.
conflicts: Socket mode UDPS/UDPC0x7532 is not evidence of discovery protocol.
Private firmware identifiers are not firmware payload addresses.
candidates.validation_needed: Vendor protocol spec or lawful passive pcap from official tool; no actual packets sent by this research.

evidence_policy.scope: Offline evidence only; not a runtime address allowlist or hardware authorization.
